## Source and targets

- S. Guo, J. Roos, P.-L. Yung, *Sharp variation-norm estimates for oscillatory integrals related to
  Carleson's theorem*, Anal. PDE 13 (2020) 1457–1500, doi:10.2140/apde.2020.13.1457,
  arXiv:1710.10988v3 (latest version, TeX dated 2019-06-04), <https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.10988>.
- Local copies: `sources/variational-sw.tex` (arXiv TeX, authoritative), `sources/1710.10988v3.pdf`.
- **Target (interpretation of R1, 2026-10-02):** Theorem 1.1 (`\label{main}`), both parts:
  (a) `‖V^r{𝓗^{(u)}f : u ∈ ℝ}‖_p ≤ C‖f‖_p` for n ≥ 1, α > 1, r ∈ (2,∞), p ∈ (1,∞), r > p'/n;
  (b) for n ≥ 2, p ∈ (2n/(2n-1),∞): `‖λ √N_λ{𝓗^{(u)}f : u ∈ ℝ}‖_p ≤ C‖f‖_p`, C independent of λ > 0.
  `C` depends on n, α, p, r (and the kernel Ω), not on f. `f` ranges over Schwartz functions (a priori bounds).
  Plus the full dependency closure of its proof (Sections 1–5, 7, and the cited results they use).
- **Excluded (interpretation):** Theorem 1.2 (sharpness; the paper verifies it only for n = 1, K = 1/t, α = 2),
  Theorem 1.6 beyond the case n = 1 actually used, Section 8 (alternative proof of local smoothing via
  decoupling), Section 9 (Krause–Lacey application), the `sgn(t)|t|^α` remark.
